name: toolbox-pod
description: Official hosted MCP server for Toolbox POD, which prints custom shirts and hoodies in its own shop in Utah and ships them to US addresses. Your AI assistant can create shirt designs from a description or reuse saved designs, show a design on the shirt in the colors you choose, price an order, prepare an order with a locked price and give you a link to pay on toolboxpod.com (the assistant never pays for you), and show order status and tracking.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint with OAuth 2.1 sign-in (dynamic client registration). Sign in or sign up to Toolbox POD when you connect; no API key.

examples.title: Design a shirt
examples.description: Create a design from a description and see it on a shirt
examples.prompt: Design a retro sunset shirt for my hiking club and show me a mockup.

examples.title: Price an order
examples.description: Price a garment, quantity, sizes and print sides
examples.prompt: How much for 24 hoodies in mixed sizes, printed front and back?

examples.title: Track an order
examples.prompt: Where is my last Toolbox POD order?
